descriptions.value: Vulnerability in the Oracle EDI Gateway product of Oracle E-Business Suite (component: All Miscellaneous EDI Issues).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.3-12.2.15. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows high privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle EDI Gateway.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle EDI Gateway. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 7.2 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).

descriptions.description: Easily exploitable vulnerability allows high privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle EDI Gateway.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle EDI Gateway.

descriptions.value: Vulnerability in Oracle Application Testing Suite (component: OpenScript).   The supported version that is affected is 13.3.0.1. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with logon to the infrastructure where Oracle Application Testing Suite executes to compromise Oracle Application Testing Suite.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Application Testing Suite. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 7.0 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).

descriptions.description: Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with logon to the infrastructure where Oracle Application Testing Suite executes to compromise Oracle Application Testing Suite.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Application Testing Suite.

descriptions.value: Vulnerability in the Oracle Partner Management product of Oracle E-Business Suite (component: Internal Operations).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.3-12.2.15. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Partner Management.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle Partner Management accessible data. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 6.5 (Confidentiality impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N).

descriptions.description: Easily exploitable vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Partner Management. descriptions.value: Vulnerability in the Siebel CRM Cloud Applications product of Oracle Siebel CRM (component: Siebel Cloud Manager).  Supported versions that are affected are 22.3-26.9. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 5.3 (Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:N).
